# Keep the hashed-name AddSubfolder callback limitation explicit

The historical mbox rename caller hashes the requested name for filesystem moves, then passes that safeFolderName to AddSubfolder. The initial Panorama branch inserts that argument into the folder table and explicitly calls the hashed name wrong for this boundary. Fixed AddSubfolder later corrects special root-name casing and uses numeric child lookup/insert, but still keeps the callback TODO. Do not treat physical filename safety as a valid logical folder identity or claim the TODO solved by those later changes. This adds one inspected rename consumer to the existing folder-representation note; it does not cover all message stores or report a reproduced failure.

Scope: Panorama compatibility database contracts.
